title: Local finite-quotient normalization data for adic fibre comparisons
statement: Fix a field $k$, a prime $\ell$ invertible in $k$, finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a normalized realization family and its actual finite-type bases, lattices, charts and geometric fibre functors [def-per-adic-fibre-comparison-data], and a family of finite comparison maps [def-per-adic-fibre-coherence-data]. Define $\operatorname{modelH0}$ by applying $H^0$ to a specified derived degree-zero presentation and removing the single-object unit. Define the finite etale unit's proetale mate using the canonical site adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Define the positive-power quotient tower of integral scalar extension, its reduction cone map, the finite scalar sheaf and tensor/sheafification unit. A pulled lattice identification must agree on every finite reduction with the pulled system unit and send each rationalized integral section to the same integral image. A scalar lattice identification must similarly agree with every finite tensor unit and its rational balanced section. Define the pullback and scalar chart predicates by the normalized global derived comparisons, actual derived counits and ordinary module units, using the intrinsic $H^0$ normalization. Define the pullback-limit predicate by existence of an adapted refinement through every specified geometric lift, with literally pulled tower and the specified integral stalk-limit comparison; its localized map conjugated by the two chart normalizations equals the recorded fibre comparison. Define the scalar-limit predicate by the finite integral quotient tensor maps, completion reduction-cone map and localization, with the prescribed pure-tensor equation. Define $\operatorname{LocalLimits}$ as the conjunction of these pullback-limit and scalar-limit predicates. These are formulas and normalization predicates only; they assert no existence of a fibre comparison family.
